release.name: affine-diversification-fibres
release.publication_readiness_note: Ready to be made public for scrutiny as an unrefereed candidate; this field does not assert theorem truth, novelty, independent reproduction or peer review.

safe_claim: Conditional on a fixed pulled speciation signal, a stated class of homogeneous time-dependent birth-death histories admits a cumulative-loss measure coordinate. Continuous turnover caps and finite interval constraints then yield sharp pointwise projections, endpoint-attaining histories where stated, finite incompatibility certificates, a positive-survival test and a minimum compatible cap. Finitely many independent deterministic survival events preserve the reconstructed-tree law only under the fixed-stem conditioning conventions proved in the manuscript.

headline_assessment.note: Indicative reviewer calibration, not an official REF judgement.

exclusions: No crown-conditioned or random-origin finite-event equivalence claim.
No posterior-equality claim for likelihood-equivalent histories.
No simultaneous confidence coverage for the pulled signal.
No validated fossil preservation, observation or genus-to-species bridge.
No performance claim against the actual CRABS implementation.
No exhaustive novelty or priority claim.

open_gates.item: External specialist audit of the fixed-stem finite-event theorem and event conventions.
Recognition search across books, theses, adjacent mathematical fields and non-English literature.
Construction and propagation of an honest simultaneous uncertainty set for the pulled signal.
Fossil preservation, observation and taxonomic-scale model.
Actual matched CRABS or equivalent software comparison under identical restrictions.
Clean recreation with the pinned container image has passed locally under normal and optimized Python; independent external replay remains not assessed.
